name: wormagent
description: 🌀 WormAgent — Your personal AI agent on your devices & channels · Official agent of WormGPT · wormagent.net

scripts.dev:live: sh -c 'WORMAGENT_TUI_CHANNEL=dev WORMAGENT_PASSWORD="$(wormagent service get password)" exec bun run dev "$@" --server "$(wormagent service status)"' --
scripts.dev:vite:live: sh -c 'WORMAGENT_TUI_CHANNEL=dev WORMAGENT_PASSWORD="$(wormagent service get password)" exec bun run dev:vite "$@" --server "$(wormagent service status)"' --
scripts.lint: oxlint && ast-grep scan -c script/ast-grep/gui-plugins/sgconfig.yml && ast-grep scan --rule script/ast-grep/dialog-size.yml packages && bun script/sdk-docs.ts && bun script/check-greys.ts
scripts.lint:effect-patterns: ast-grep scan -c script/ast-grep/sgconfig.yml packages/util/src packages/core/src packages/server/src packages/protocol/src packages/cli/src
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: echo 'do not run tests from root' && exit 1
scripts.build: echo "✅ Hostinger build" && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && ls -lh dist/

author: wormgpt-app <admin@wormgpt.app>
